name: hand-ergonomics
description: Checks that a hand-held device's controls are within reach, counting ANSUR 1988 subjects one by one, on a layout that matches the drawn scene; proposes reach maps.

provides_proposers.description: Maps where each grip's thumb and index finger reach, as a share of ANSUR 1988 subjects; counts controls of a pitch in reach; gives grip spacing and design ranges.

lenses: the smallest hand in the range
centre controls on a two-handed device
what stands proud of the face
the largest insert in its open pose
origin: built by the extension protocol from ANSUR 1988 (per-subject public files, NATICK/TR-89/044) and ANSUR II, after a hand-held device's printed enclosure that passed every geometry check was rejected in the hand
